definitions.explanation: A dish of various vegetables quickly cooked in a hot pan or wok with oil. A staple of everyday Japanese home cooking and a common menu item at restaurants.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}は{野菜炒|やさいいた}めにしよう。
examples.english: Let's have stir-fried vegetables for dinner tonight.

examples.japanese: {肉|にく}と{野菜炒|やさいいた}めの{定食|ていしょく}を{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I ordered the meat and vegetable stir-fry set meal.

examples.japanese: {野菜炒|やさいいた}めは{強火|つよび}で{一気|いっき}に{炒|いた}めるのがコツだ。
examples.english: The trick to stir-fried vegetables is to cook them all at once over high heat.

notes:
One of the most basic and common dishes in Japanese home cooking. Quick, cheap, and nutritious.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {野菜炒|やさいいた}めを{作|つく}る (to make stir-fried vegetables)
- {野菜炒|やさいいた}め{定食|ていしょく} (stir-fried vegetable set meal)
- {肉|にく}{野菜炒|やさいいた}め (meat and vegetable stir-fry)

USAGE NOTE:
The ～{炒|いた}め pattern is productive: {豚肉炒|ぶたにくいた}め (stir-fried pork), もやし{炒|いた}め (stir-fried bean sprouts), etc. {野菜炒|やさいいた}め is the most representative example of this pattern.
